description: Visual plugin market inside DeepSeek Harness — browse, search, and one-click install community plugins. · DSH 可视化插件市场：逛一逛，点一下，装好。
finalEn: Adds a visual plugin market inside DeepSeek Harness, so you can browse, search and install community plugins from the web UI in one click.

description: A community plugin marketplace for DeepSeek Harness, built to the official plugin spec — browse, search and install 6000+ hand-verified npm plugins out of 23000+ indexed, without leaving the app. · DeepSeek Harness 社区插件市场（遵循官方开发规范）：收录 23000+ 社区插件，其中 6000+
finalEn: Adds a community plugin marketplace built to the official plugin spec, with browse, search and install for thousands of hand-verified npm plugins.

description: The DeepSeek Harness plugin catalog (10778 entries) · DeepSeek Harness 插件目录
finalEn: Ships the DeepSeek Harness plugin catalog as one JSON file with 10778 entries, so other tools can read the index without scraping a website.

description: DeepSeek Harness 会话费用统计插件:本会话成本、当日费用、历史记录与官方价格同步,支持多厂商多模型价格计费(内置 170+ 模型 ID 价格目录与自动匹配)、主流 Coding Plan 订阅额度查询与显示(16 家,含 WorkBuddy 官方积分、OpenDesign 工作区查询、含小米 MiMo Token Plan 控制台 Cookie 查询、SCNet Token Plan 本地 Credits 计量与火山方舟 Volcano Ark Coding Plan AK/SK 签名查询
finalEn: Adds a session cost readout to the web UI: this session, today, history, and per-model pricing from a built-in table of 170 model prices.

description: DSH Web 界面右下角的 DeepSeek 余额小鲸鱼挂件:余额/今日已用/峰谷定价、自定义泡泡点击序列(文本/余额/今日/峰谷/图片/随机语句与并列加权选择)、逐行样式与字体、悬浮快捷编辑、音效与每轮消耗、自定义角色/动图/音效、吸附与翻转自定义
finalEn: Puts a DeepSeek balance widget in the bottom-right corner, showing balance, today usage and peak pricing, with a configurable bubble click sequence.

description: 归档、恢复、收藏和永久删除会话，并诊断损坏的会话日志。 · Archive, restore, favorite, and permanently delete sessions, and diagnose damaged session logs.
finalEn: Adds archive, restore, favorite and permanent delete actions to every session row, and diagnoses damaged session logs so broken entries can be repaired.

description: Session-level superagent for DeepSeek Harness: watch a GitHub repository and wake a session when something needs doing. Credentials never reach the model.
finalEn: Watches a GitHub repository and wakes a session when something needs doing, keeping credentials on the host instead of sending them to the model.

description: DSH Skills Manager — 在 DeepSeek Harness 中统一加载并安全管理本机 Agent Skills · Load and safely manage local Agent Skills in DSH
finalEn: Adds a sidebar panel that loads and manages local Agent Skills, so you can enable, disable and inspect them without editing files by hand.

description: Free web search for DeepSeek Harness: 39 engines (Bing/DuckDuckGo/AnySearch/SearXNG/Exa/Tavily/Keenable/Firecrawl/Parallel/You.com keyless; Zhihu global/site via MCP and Perplexity/SerpBase/DeepSeek (official + native tools/search)/Baidu/Kimi/Aliyun/Douba
finalEn: Gives the agent free web search across 39 engines, including keyless providers, so answers can cite pages the model could not reach on its own.

description: The strongest free web search plugin for coding agents. Plug-in web search, X search, and page fetch for models without native web access. Free out of the box: no signup, no API key (Firecrawl keyless, 1,000 free credits/month)
finalEn: Adds web search, X search and page fetch for models without native web access, with keyless providers so it runs without signup or an API key.

description: DeepSeek Harness 换肤插件（Dream Skin for DSH）：8 套 iOS / Linear 式清透冷调的高质感主题 + 弥散光壁纸 + 每皮肤智能背景 + 强调色 + 主题包分享，把换肤做成材质与配色克制的高级感工艺，而非贴图。Works in native DSH Web and third-party desktop clients (DSH Desktop): 8 original premium themes, glass materials, wallpaper 2.0
finalEn: Installs eight cool-toned iOS and Linear style themes with diffuse wallpapers, accent colours and per-skin backgrounds, switchable from the settings page.

description: Claude Code Desktop theme for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) web GUI — visual & interaction overhaul
finalEn: Reworks the web client look and interaction to match Claude Code Desktop, changing colours, spacing and controls together rather than one at a time.

description: Wallpaper Engine backgrounds for the DSH web GUI: render your local Wallpaper Engine wallpapers behind the chat — Scene and Web in real time through the bundled WebWallGL engine, Video played directly — with iOS-style liquid glass, adjustable blur/scrim/b
finalEn: Renders local Wallpaper Engine wallpapers behind the chat, playing Scene and Web backgrounds in real time through the desktop runtime.

description: 吃白饭的蓝色大肥鱼，赖在 DeepSeek Harness 里不走了。平时爱玩魔方、爱吃各种零食、偶尔打个盹，闲不住就在桌面上溜达两圈，被你拖来甩去也照旧赖着；你忙起来它跟着忙前忙后，也会帮你打理余额钱包，闲下来爱碎碎念，还乐意陪你唠两句。
finalEn: Adds a small animated fish that wanders the screen, plays with objects, naps, follows your work and keeps the balance wallet in view.

description: DeepSeek Harness 表情包插件：输入框一键发图（图库/情绪多选筛选、悬浮大图预览）、多图库开关、情绪与关键词搜图、AI 学图，图库可从市场一键安装或导入/导出 ZIP。
finalEn: Adds a meme picker beside the message box plus a tool the agent calls to send an image, with multiple galleries, mood filters and AI-learned images.

description: AgentTeams for DeepSeek Harness: multi-agent team collaboration (captain, members, tasks with dependencies, messaging) driven by natural language, with a tree monitor in the web GUI
finalEn: Adds multi-agent teamwork with a captain, members, dependent tasks and messaging, driven by natural language, plus a tree monitor in the web interface.

description: 同一需求，2–4 版真跑：在 DSH 主对话里比较回答、文件与网页，选风格，盲选或公开对比，再审查采用。Compare 2–4 answers, files or live pages in DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Desktop and Web, then review and adopt.
finalEn: Runs the same request through two to four models and shows answers, files or live pages side by side, with blind or open comparison before you adopt one.

description: Mobile API (/api/mobile/v1) and relay client for the DSH mobile app — desktop profile build (dsh 0.2.x, peers resolved by the host)
finalEn: Exposes a mobile API and relay client so the DSH mobile app can reach a desktop profile, resolving peers through the host instead of bundling them.

description: Remote SSH development for DeepSeek Harness: optional IDE layout, remote file and content search, native editor and terminal tabs, Git diffs, and agent tools with compiler diagnostics.
finalEn: Adds remote SSH development to the client: IDE layout, remote search, editor and terminal tabs, Git diffs and agent access to the remote machine.

description: P2P-based, end-to-end encrypted remote access to DeepSeek Harness, CodeX, Claude Code, Pi, and other workspaces from web and mobile clients.
finalEn: Gives you peer-to-peer, end-to-end encrypted remote access to DeepSeek Harness workspaces from web and mobile clients, without exposing a port.

description: 把微信、飞书、企微、钉钉、QQ、Telegram、WhatsApp、Slack、Discord、Matrix接入DSH。 Connect Telegram, WhatsApp, Slack, Discord, Matrix, WeChat, Feishu, WeCom, DingTalk, and QQ to DSH.
finalEn: Bridges WeChat, Feishu, WeCom, DingTalk, QQ, Telegram, WhatsApp, Slack, Discord and Matrix into DSH, so you can talk to an agent from any of them.

description: 在 QQ 私聊和群聊里直接对话 DeepSeek Harness。 Chat with DeepSeek Harness in QQ private and group chats.
finalEn: Chats with DeepSeek Harness inside QQ private and group chats, so the agent answers where the conversation already happens instead of another window.

description: GenUI for DeepSeek Harness: interactive charts, forms, calculators, dashboards, and mini apps rendered inline in assistant replies, with actions that flow back to the model.
finalEn: Renders interactive charts, forms, calculators, dashboards and small apps inline in replies, with actions that report results back to the agent.

description: Deep View: interactive views (charts, tables, inputs, answers) in any DeepSeek Harness chat
finalEn: Renders interactive charts, tables, inputs and answers inside any chat, so data in a reply can be inspected rather than read as plain text.

description: DSH × Univer integration with a bundled collaboration Gateway and Viewer: inline previews, live floating Worktree windows, and session-end review actions in DeepSeek Harness.
finalEn: Previews spreadsheets and documents inline, opens them in floating worktree windows, and adds a session-end review step through a bundled gateway.

description: Native file and PTC tools for DSH on Windows x64, Linux x64 and macOS arm64/x64; Windows-only optional Bash payload and host PowerShell integration
finalEn: Adds native file and process tools on Windows, Linux and macOS, with an optional Bash payload and PowerShell integration on Windows only.

description: DSH 桌面端自己的刷新按钮：改插件不用重启、开久了卡了也点一下，正在进行的会话不受影响。
finalEn: Adds a reload button to the desktop client, so plugin changes apply without a restart and a long-running window can be refreshed in place.

description: Windows desktop automation for DeepSeek Harness — plugs CursorTouch/Windows-MCP (screenshot, UI automation, input, clipboard, processes, registry) into DSH through the official MCP client bridge.
finalEn: Connects Windows-MCP to DSH, giving the agent screenshots, UI automation, input, clipboard, process and registry access on a Windows desktop.

description: Interactive terminal interface for DeepSeek Harness agents, sessions and tools.
finalEn: Adds an interactive terminal interface for agents, sessions and tools, so a whole session can run in the terminal instead of the browser.

description: 在 DSH 中使用 Claude Code、Codex 等软件生态的插件，一站式管理插件、Skills 与 MCP。支持添加 Git 插件源和 marketplace、上传插件和 Skills、添加 MCP 服务器，自动扫描并开关本地 Skills，接入插件提供的子代理、MCP、Hooks 与 LSP。
finalEn: Brings Claude Code and Codex plugin sources into DSH, managing plugins, skills and MCP servers from one panel, including Git sources and local uploads.

description: DSH 技能市场与 MCP 连接器市场：浏览实时技能源，一键安装 SKILL.md 技能与 MCP 连接器，装完即刻可用、无需重启。SKILL & MCP marketplace for DeepSeek Harness — browse live sources, install skills and MCP connectors, effective immediately.
finalEn: Adds a skills and MCP marketplace: browse live sources, install SKILL.md skills and MCP connectors, and use them immediately without restarting.

description: Skills manager for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: a sidebar panel that lists skills by install location, edits and disables them, diagnoses silently skipped skills, and installs skills from market indexes.
finalEn: Adds a sidebar panel that lists skills by install location, edits and disables them, reports skills skipped without an error, and installs from market indexes.

description: 技能浏览器：悬浮球打开面板，把本机技能库变成可浏览、可检索、可治理的资产——五个 Tab（技能浏览/调用台账/MCP 管理/市场/快速上手）、树状/平铺双视图、手动+关键词+AI 三种分组（分组只改视图不动技能文件）、调用台账看板（调用次数/成功率/趋势图/技能调用排行）、130 款三球同步皮肤（6 列宽屏菜单）、9 步快速上手、MCP 管理（读取运行时 MCP 配置、真实连接状态、工具清单与自动功能概括、调用统计落盘、启停即时跟随/重连/卸载/导出标准 mcpServers JSON、重绘不跳顶且面板记
finalEn: Turns the local skill library into a browsable panel with five tabs, tree and grid views, call ledgers and charts, plus market and MCP management.

description: Full-functionality evolution bundle — DEFAULT install: host automation + model tools, all profile-root (community build)
finalEn: Installs the full evolution bundle: host automation plus model tools at the profile root, as the default build of this community project.

description: Web surface for skill health: the sidebar panel that shows what the linter found (community build)
finalEn: Adds a sidebar panel that shows what the skill linter found, listing parse and load problems for the skills installed in this profile.

description: User-editable CSS themes and background images for the DSH Web GUI and Desktop app, with pickers in Settings
finalEn: Adds user-editable CSS themes and background images for the web and desktop clients, with the pickers placed in the settings page.

description: Removes every corner radius from the DSH Web interface.
finalEn: Removes every corner radius from the web interface, turning rounded buttons, cards and inputs into square ones across the whole client.

description: Collapses the global panel entries above the workspace in the DSH Web left sidebar into one toggle, with a grid-display settings page
finalEn: Collapses the sidebar entries above the workspace into a single toggle, with a settings page that controls how the folded group is displayed.

description: AI Shell brand reskin for DSH web — replaces sidebar and hero brand marks with AI Shell SVG
finalEn: Replaces the sidebar and hero brand marks with AI Shell SVG artwork, so the client carries that product identity instead of the default one.

description: dsh plugin: SYSTEM proxy (env) + LLM traffic-splitting proxy via a process-global undici routing dispatcher
finalEn: Installs a process-wide HTTP proxy plus an LLM traffic-splitting dispatcher, so model calls from different providers can be routed separately.

description: DeepSeek Harness database tool plugin — SQL Server / PostgreSQL / MySQL over native drivers, multi-source, read-only by default, credentials stay host-side (no MCP server in between)
finalEn: Adds SQL Server, PostgreSQL and MySQL tools over native drivers, with multiple data sources, read-only queries by default and credentials kept on the host.

description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: one hub for AI coding providers — account login, multi-account pools, silent credential refresh, credit claiming, and a local OpenAI-compatible gateway
finalEn: Adds one hub for AI coding providers: account login, multi-account pools, silent credential refresh, credit claiming and a local provider list.

description: SSH remote workspaces for the dsh web GUI, reusing the session sandbox mode and approval flow.
finalEn: Adds SSH remote workspaces to the web client, reusing the session sandbox mode and the existing approval flow for every command.

description: DSH Web plugin: create and remove git worktrees from the conversation UI
finalEn: Creates and removes git worktrees from the conversation interface, so a task can run in its own checkout without leaving the chat.

description: IDE tab for the dsh web client: a VSCode-style read-only code viewer with the Dark Modern theme, registered into the conversation view ring.
finalEn: Adds an IDE tab with a VSCode-style read-only code viewer in the Dark Modern theme, registered into the conversation view ring.

description: Connect your own machines to a DSH Web deployment and run commands on them from the agent.
finalEn: Connects your own machines to a DSH deployment and lets the agent run commands on them, extending a session past the local host.

description: Official remote cloud relay plugin for DSHost (dshost.me): securely access your dsh Web UI from anywhere
finalEn: Relays the dsh web UI through the DSHost cloud service, so you can reach your local interface from anywhere without opening a port.

description: Declarative design-panel interpreter for the dsh Web UI: renders Design Files as editable panels in a conversation.view workspace.
finalEn: Interprets declarative design files as editable panels inside a conversation workspace, so a layout can be adjusted and reviewed in place.

description: DSH 代码图谱可视化插件 - 打通 dsh-codegraph/dsh-tool-lens 数据源 → 聚合转换 → 交互式代码图谱
finalEn: Turns code-graph data from the codegraph and tool-lens sources into an interactive graph, aggregating the input before rendering it.

description: 工具白名单延迟加载(全局层与全部 per-agent scope 层):白名单内工具全量注入,白名单外统一打 deferLoading 交给宿主 deferred tool loading 链(API 服务端按需搜索激活);声明式收敛,行退场按 undo journal 还原原状
finalEn: Keeps only whitelisted tools in the request and defers everything else to the host deferred loading chain, preserving an undo journal for each removal.

description: DSH 工具公告面子插件：把每轮随请求发送的工具定义收到一份实测白名单，并把被撤下工具的参数写进系统提示词。
finalEn: Trims the tool definitions sent with each turn to a measured whitelist, and writes the parameters of removed tools into the system prompt.

description: Oh My Pi bash runtime ported as a deepseek-harness tool plugin: persistent shell session, output minimizer, managed background jobs, command interception
finalEn: Ports the Oh My Pi bash runtime into a tool plugin, adding a persistent shell, output minimisation, managed background jobs and command interception.

description: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) plugin for octop-memory: recall shared memory before each turn and report each turn afterwards.
finalEn: Recalls shared memory before each turn and reports the turn afterwards, so context from earlier sessions can reach the current one.

description: Cross-platform (macOS + Windows) DeepSeek Harness plugin that syncs DSH config — skills, profile settings, AGENTS.md — with a private dsh-config repository.
finalEn: Syncs skills, profile settings and AGENTS.md with a private config repository on macOS and Windows, keeping two machines on one configuration.

description: Manual multi-source update checks and update plans for DeepSeek Harness plugin bundles.
finalEn: Checks several sources for plugin bundle updates and produces an update plan, leaving the actual installation for you to approve.

description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: the claude-whiteboard skill from baoyu-design. The agent lays out diagrams, flows, maps of ideas and plans on a whiteboard and opens it in a local board editor where you move, draw and comment.
finalEn: Adds the claude-whiteboard skill, so the agent lays out diagrams, flows and plans on a whiteboard and plays the result back in the session.

description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: the claude-motion skill from baoyu-design. The agent writes short animated films as code, scene by scene, and plays them in a local Motion player that exports MP4 or GIF.
finalEn: Adds the claude-motion skill, so the agent writes short animated films as code, scene by scene, and plays them inside the session.

description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: scheduled collection tasks that each file a timestamped report.
finalEn: Adds scheduled collection tasks that each file a timestamped report, so recurring checks leave a dated trail without manual runs.

description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: browse, preview and export Unreal Engine 4/5 assets from local PAK archives through CUE4Parse.
finalEn: Browses, previews and exports Unreal Engine 4 and 5 assets from local PAK archives through CUE4Parse, without opening the editor.

description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: Xirang workbench for the requirement → development → defect pipeline.
finalEn: Adds a workbench for the requirement to development to defect pipeline, tracking each stage inside DSH rather than across separate tools.

description: Composable, view-based context for DeepSeek Harness. Pluggable sources and strategies, with layered memory and self-evolving skills out of the box.
finalEn: Provides composable view-based context with pluggable sources and strategies, plus layered memory and self-evolving skills available on install.

description: AI image generation plugin for the dsh web GUI: text-to-image and image-to-image through configurable provider channels (gpt-image-2 / grok-imagine-image / nanobanana series / seedream-5.0-pro / dall-e-3, with native xAI Grok Imagine, Google Nano Banana a
finalEn: Generates and edits images in the web client through configurable provider channels, covering text-to-image and image-to-image from the chat.
